snippet.title: No Man's Sky Voyagers Update - Deep Dive
snippet.description:
Introducing..No Man's Sky Voyagers (Update 6.0)

Sean describes some of the insane new ship-building features we're introducing in the Voyagers 6.0 update and hints at some of the development challenges the tiny team at Hello Games have had to overcome in one of our biggest updates yet.

Full patch notes here: https://www.nomanssky.com/voyagers-update
